title: Link-transcript version/activation machinery absent: RSV3 mixed-activation rule unenforceable
description:
Req R-02-034 (spec/02-physical-link.md 4.1, MUST): 'Rule Set Version 3 deployments use Link Signature Domain Version 1; mixed activation MUST be handled as a network upgrade and MUST NOT accept both transcripts for the same frame.'

Classification: not-implemented (invariant holds only structurally).
Evidence: no version/activation field or selector exists in any implementation; each has exactly one hard-coded domain constant (rust/lichen-link/src/schnorr.rs:28, python/src/lichen/link/frame.py:31, lichen/subsys/lichen/link/schnorr48.c:284 with _Static_assert). Legacy/other-domain rejection is tested (rust schnorr.rs:655-699; lichen/tests/schnorr48_interop/main.c:284-301) but there is no executable mixed-activation test and no link-frame field carries a domain/rule-set version. SCHC RULE_SET_VERSION=3 (rust/lichen-schc/src/rules.rs:27, DIO option 0x13) is a separate mechanism not bound to link transcripts.

Suggested placement: needs a spec decision on the activation signal (network-upgrade policy or frame field) before code; coordinate with spec/09 rule-set versioning. Flagged for Opus: docs/spec-coverage-02-physical-link-flagged.md.
